movesets.name: Swords Dance (Fire)
movesets.description:
Swords Dance Ogerpon-H is the big dog of Fire teams courtesy of Hearthflame Mask increasing its damage output, its part Grass typing allowing it to fire back in the Water and Ground matchups, and Mold Breaker ignoring abilities from threatening foes such as Dondozo and Heatran. After a Swords Dance, Ivy Cudgel allows Ogerpon-H to easily break through bulky foes such as Hisuian Goodra, Clodsire, and Life Orb Landorus. Horn Leech provides the utility to regenerate health while exerting offensive pressure, letting Ogerpon-H threaten Mamoswine, Hisuian Samurott, and Urshifu-R after a boost. At +2, Play Rough improves the matchup against Dragon-types, threatening an OHKO on Garchomp and Dragonite.

Ninetales and Torkoal are the most prominent partners of Ogerpon-H, as they set sun, allowing its Ivy Cudgel to OHKO foes like Life Orb Landorus and OHKO bulky foes such as Gliscor, Iron Hands, and Galarian Weezing after a Swords Dance. Ninetales provides utility by burning foes such as Urshifu-R and non-Choice Scarf Great Tusk with Will-O-Wisp, using Healing Wish to give Ogerpon-H another chance to sweep once it has been chipped down, and using Encore to allow Ogerpon-H to set up on Pokemon locked into a move such as Sableye, Pecharunt, and Toxapex. On the other hand, Torkoal provides entry hazard control through Rapid Spin, threatens Roaring Moon with Body Press while tanking its moves, and sets up Stealth Rock to chip foes such as Alolan Muk and Spectrier, allowing Ogerpon-H to sweep more easily. Cinderace is another ally that assists with hazard removal due to Court Change, which covers for Ogerpon-H's weakness to hazards. It also serves as a fast pivot via U-turn and provides priority in Sucker Punch, removing chipped foes. Heatran, while being a temporary Ground immunity with the help of Air Balloon, also traps and removes Toxapex, which is a big annoyance to Ogerpon-H. It also notably OHKOes Flutter Mane with Heavy Slam, which can threaten a chipped Ogerpon-H with Power Gem. Volcarona and Ceruledge are fellow setup sweepers that appreciate Ogerpon-H's ability to weaken threatening foes such as Hisuian Goodra and Ting-Lu so they can clean up late-game.

strategies.comments:
Other Options

Fire

Power Whip allows Ogerpon-H to threaten Toxapex after a Swords Dance, which can annoy it normally. Rock Tomb is another alternative that lets Ogerpon-H deal with Moltres. Trailblaze allows Ogerpon-H to outspeed faster threats like Iron Valiant and Greninja.

Grass

Knock Off can be used in order to provide coverage against Skeledirge while also removing key items such as Heavy-Duty Boots from the likes of Dragonite and Pelipper. Power Whip with Rillaboom support can be used to OHKO Toxapex with Grassy Terrain and minimal chip damage.

movesets.name: Swords Dance (Grass)
movesets.description:
Ogerpon-H is an invaluable asset on Grass teams. With Swords Dance and the damage bonus from Hearthflame Mask, Ogerpon-H serves as a strong wallbreaker, and its Fire typing also gives Grass teams a hand in both the Steel and Ice matchups. Aside from this, its access to Mold Breaker allows it to bypass abilities such as Heatran's Flash Fire, Dondozo's Unaware, and Dragonite's Multiscale. With Hearthflame Mask, Ivy Cudgel turns into a powerful Fire-type move, and combined with its Speed, Ogerpon-H is able to beat the likes of Alolan Ninetales and Corviknight before a Swords Dance boost, as well as Hisuian Goodra after. Horn Leech grants Ogerpon-H some form of longevity. Play Rough allows Ogerpon-H to threaten the likes of Kommo-o, and after a Swords Dance Boost, it can 2HKO Dragonite. Alternatively, Trailblaze gives Ogerpon-H potential as a sweeper. After one Trailblaze, Ogerpon-H outspeeds the likes of Weavile and Choice Specs Greninja. Lastly, with Zen Headbutt, Ogerpon-H can surprise would-be switch-ins such as Toxapex, Clodsire, and Iron Moth.

Entry hazard support from the likes of Brambleghast and Toedscruel is appreciated to wear down foes into OHKO range from Ogerpon-H. Notably, Ogerpon-H has a chance to OHKO Bulky Bisharp with one layer of Spikes. The two of them also have access to Rapid Spin, allowing them to remove hazards so that Ogerpon-H has more opportunities to switch in without getting worn down. Toedscruel can also take Fire-type attacks from Iron Moth and KO it back, while Brambleghast can switch into a predicted Flying-type move as well as revenge kill Flutter Mane with Shadow Sneak. Amoonguss is another great teammate, as its bulk and access to Spore allow it to either incapacitate or force out foes such as Dragonite. Choice Scarf Meowscarada outspeeds and removes potential threats to Ogerpon-H like Spectrier and faster Dragon-types, and it can bring Ogerpon-H in safely. Ogerpon-H's wallbreaking enables sweepers such as Hisuian Liligant and Torterra. In return, the two of them can handle foes Ogerpon-H struggles with, such as Landorus for the former and Toxapex for the latter. Rillaboom is a great revenge killer and wallbreaker to pair with Ogerpon-H, as with Grassy Glide, it can remove faster threats such as Flutter Mane and Hoopa-U. Aside from this, Rillaboom also provides Grassy Terrain to boost the power of Ogerpon-H's Grass-type moves. In return, Rillaboom appreciates Ogerpon-H removing foes Rillaboom struggles with such as Corviknight and Articuno. Breloom is another great teammate, as due to its Fighting typing and access to Mach Punch, it can easily deal with Greninja. Lastly, Abomasnow has some niche as a teammate, as it can set up Aurora Veil to make Ogerpon-H and its teammates harder to KO.

movesets.name: Cudgel Bonk
movesets.description:
• Ogerpon-H uses Wood Hammer to deal huge damage, allowing it to OHKO Diancie and both Ursaluna formes. Horn Leech can be used instead to increase its longevity at the cost of dealing a lot less damage.
  • Ogerpon-H provides redirection, allowing its allies to set up or position safely. Ogerpon-H is particularly good at redirecting Spore from Amoonguss due to its immunity.
  • Focus Energy can be run over Follow Me to increase Ogerpon-H's offensive prowess. This allows Ivy Cudgel to always be a critical hit, letting Ogerpon-H ignore Attack drops from Incineroar's Intimidate and damage reduction from Alolan Ninetales's Aurora Veil.
  • When Ogerpon-H Terastallizes, Embody Aspect enables it to easily threaten Kyurem in snow through Aurora Veil with Ivy Cudgel, and it loses its weakness to Sludge Bomb from Landorus and Bleakwind Storm from Tornadus. Ogerpon-H is capable of OHKOing Landorus and 2HKOing Iron Hands and Cresselia with Ivy Cudgel thanks to Terastallization.
  • Ogerpon-H is primarily used as an offensive threat, capable of OHKOing prominent offensive and support Pokemon, such as Gholdengo, Rillaboom, Amoonguss, and Sinistcha.
  • Ogerpon-H synergizes well with Chien-Pao, since it can easily threaten Landorus and Tornadus, which Ogerpon-H is offensively threatened by due to their strong STAB move. Ogerpon-H threatens Steel-types Chien-Pao struggles against such as Gholdengo and Kingambit.
  • Ground-types such as Landorus and Ursaluna-B greatly appreciate Ogerpon-H's ability to threaten Rillaboom, which threatens both with its potent Wood Hammer and Grassy Glide. Meanwhile, both can easily dispatch Raging Bolt, which Ogerpon-H struggles against.
  • Dragon-type partners, such as Raging Bolt and Regidrago, appreciate Ogerpon-H KOing threats like Chien-Pao and Alolan Ninetales as well as common redirectors like Amoonguss and Sinistcha. Ogerpon-H's redirection utility additionally allows Raging Bolt to easily set up with Calm Mind. In return, Raging Bolt can easily dispatch Ogerpon-W, opposing Raging Bolt, and Roaring Moon, which threaten Ogerpon-H and are tricky for it to defeat. Meanwhile, Regidrago's Dragon Energy can remove Dragon-types that Ogerpon-H struggles to damage.
  • Ogerpon-H supports Steel-types like Gholdengo and Kingambit exceptionally well. Ogerpon-H threatens opposing Steel-types its teammates struggle to damage as well as Ground-types that threaten them like the Ursaluna formes. In return, Gholdengo provides a strong special offensive presence to complement Ogerpon-H's physical offense, and Kingambit dissuades Intimidate cycling from Incineroar thanks to Defiant.
  • Ogerpon-H works very well on a core of Gholdengo, Tornadus,and Regidrago, taking advantage of their offensive coverage and Tailwind support as well as providing its own offensive coverage as well as redirection.

movesets.name: ALL STAR
movesets.description:
• With its great offensive presence and incredible ability in Mold Breaker, Ogerpon-H is one of the premier threats in Battle Stadium Singles.

  • Ivy Cudgel: Ivy Cudgel offers a consistent STAB move with an elevated critical hit rate, allowing Ogerpon-H to power through even foes that resist Fire.

  • Horn Leech VS. Trailblaze: Horn Leech provides a consistent Grass-type STAB move and a form of healing to assist in longevity; however, Trailblaze’s Speed boost can allow Ogerpon-H to take over games on the spot if given the chance.

  • Play Rough VS. Rock Tomb: Play Rough is good coverage for foes such as Dragonite and the Urshifu formes, as well as Pokemon that might try to use Tera Dragon to resist Ogerpon-H’s STAB combination. Rock Tomb doesn't hit as many Dragon-types, but in exchange offers speed control and is Ogerpon-H's best attack against Fire-types like Ho-Oh and Incineroar.

  • Swords Dance: Swords Dance boosts Ogerpon-H’s Attack to frightening levels, and thanks to Mold Breaker, it cannot be ignored by the likes of Unaware Dondozo.

  • Quick Attack: While difficult to run without giving up Swords Dance, Quick Attack is great for cleaning up late game with Embody Aspect.

Other Options

  • Knock Off: Knock Off provides team support with its item removal, removing pesky items like Porygon2's Eviolite and the rare Skeledirge's Ability Shield. It's coverage isn't as good as the other options though.

  • Encore: Ogerpon-H’s good Speed allows it to make decent use of encore to lock foes into utility moves, providing itself or its teammates turns to set up.

  • Substitute: Substitute when paired with Swords Dance is a huge help against Dragon Tail Archaludon, though this will come at the cost of coverage.

EV Spreads

  • 252 HP / 100 Atk / 92 Def / 60 Spe with Adamant: This spread outspeeds Iron Bundle after Trailblaze while avoiding a 2HKO from Focus Sash Chien-Pao's Sucker Punch; however, it will no longer outspeed Urshifu.

Tera Types

The Hearthflame Mask grants Ogerpon-H a Fire Tera type. When Ogerpon-H Terastallizes, it is given a new ability, Embody Aspect, Which boosts Ogerpon-H’s attack. However, it will no longer have access to Mold Breaker.

movesets.name: Bulky-pon
movesets.description:
• Ogerpon-H's incredible power in Embody Aspect, unique typing, and utility-laden movepool make it the crown jewel of bulky Fire-types!

  • Rock Tomb: Rock Tomb provides fantastic speed control and punishes common switch-ins like Dragonite and Ho-Oh.

  • Quick Attack: Quick Attack pairs beautifully with Embody Aspect to pick off weakened foes late-game.

  • Encore: Even without Swords Dance to set up with, Encore is still a great way to punish support moves from Pokemon that Ogerpon-H otherwise struggles with such as Archaludon and Tera Poison Garganacl.

  • Swords Dance: Even with this set's focus on bulk, Ogerpon-H is fully capable of charging through slower teams after a boost, with common stall team members like Dondozo being particularly juicy targets thanks to Mold Breaker.

  • Synthesis: Synthesis is Ogerpon-Hs most reliable form of recovery, sacrificing offensive utility for longevity.

Other Options

  • Taunt: Taunt is a good way to stop Stealth Rock from flying up from the likes of Ting-Lu and Archaludon, in addition to making Clear Amulet Dragonite switch ins easier to handle.

  • Power Whip: The accuracy can be a big issue, but in addition to greater power, it won't be blocked by Psychic Noise from Primarina and Lugia like Horn Leech

EV Spreads

  • Ogerpon-H is very customizable in terms of EVs, so only take these as examples. For more exact fine-tuning, feel free to experiment with our damage calculator!

  • 252 HP / 4 Atk / 60 Def / 36 SpD / 156 Spe with Adamant: This spread survives Adamant Choice Scarf Urshifu-R's Tera Water Surging Strikes while outspeeding the more problematic Adamant Punching Glove Urshifu-R. The Special Defense EVs give Ogerpon-H a high chance of surviving both Blood Moon and Vacuum Wave from Ursaluna-B that lack an offensive item.

  • 252 HP / 4 Atk / 156 Def / 36 SpD / 60 Spe with Adamant: This spread sacrifices some Speed to survive even Adamant Punching Glove Urshifu-R's Tera Water Surging Strikes while still usually surviving Blood Moon followed by Vacuum Wave from Assault Vest Ursaluna-B. The Speed investment outspeeds Modest Gholdengo, Jolly Breloom, and up to Timid Iron Bundle after Rock Tomb.

  • 236 HP / 212 Defense / 60 Spe with Impish: This extremely defensive spread sacrifices plenty of power and some reliability against Ursaluna-B, but makes Ogerpon-H so physically durable that even Jolly Focus Sash Chien-Pao will fail to 2HKO Ogerpon-H! The bulk also gives Ogerpon-H its 2nd-best ah shot at surviving Jolly Choice Band Tera Water Urshifu-R's Surging Strikes at around 69%, while the Speed EVs outspeed Timid Iron Bundle after being smacked by Rock Tomb's Speed debuff.

Tera Types

  • Embody Aspect: Ogerpon-H is locked into a Tera Fire, but it trades that and Mold Breaker in exchange for an Attack boost via Embody Aspect! This is perfect for cleaning up teams late-game and saving Ogerpon-H from opposing Ogerpon-H, but note that it completely nullifies Ogerpon-H's potential to check Urshifu-R rc and can open it up to being picked off by other Aqua Jet users like Basculegion and Primarina late-game.

strategies.overview:
• With a solid stat spread, incredible damage output with Terastallization, a unique typing and access to utility such as Follow Me, Ogerpon-H can provide some unique assets to a team.

  • Ogerpon-H has a strong STAB combination that is only walled by Fire- and Dragon-types. Because of this, some of its best partners include Urshifu-R, Landorus and Flutter Mane, which are all powerful attackers that pair well with Ogerpon-H and enjoy Follow Me support. Another strong partner is Kingambit, which dissuades Intimidate from weakening Ogerpon-H, while Follow Me provides an opportunity for Swords Dance Kingambit to set up.

  • Ogerpon-H becomes an extremely powerful offensive threat once Terastallized, being able to OHKO metagame staples like Flutter Mane, Urshifu-R, Rillaboom, and Landorus. Ogerpon-H also has a fantastic matchup against Amoonguss; not only is it able to completely ignore Amoongus's Spore and Rage Powder, but it is also able to OHKO it with Ivy Cudgel or with Wood Hammer should Amoonguss Terastallize into a Water-type. Additionally, Mystic Water variants of Urshifu-R get outsped and OHKOed.

  • Bad matchups for Ogerpon-H include Pokemon such as Entei and Raging Bolt that can wall its STAB combation. For this reason, as well as Intimidate hampering Ogerpon-H's offensive capabilities, Incineroar is a very stable check to it. Lastly, despite having solid bulk, powerful threats that can outspeed Ogerpon-H can OHKO it such as Choice Scarf Urshifu-R. However, with speed control or Fake Out support from Pokemon like Rillaboom, Ogerpon-H can take on Choice Scarf Urshifu-R.

movesets.name: Offensive
movesets.description:
• Horn Leech trades Wood Hammer's power for greater longevity.

  • Follow Me is by far the best third move on this Pokemon, but if the team does not require a redirector, Ogerpon-H can use Grassy Glide; if this is the case, it is almost always paired with Rillaboom to ensure Grassy Glide is a priority move. Alternatively, Stomping Tantrum allows it to hit opposing Fire-types such as Entei and Chi-Yu.

  • The Speed EVs allow Ogerpon-H to outspeed Modest Landorus and Adamant Urshifu-R. The Attack EVs with the Adamant nature allow it to OHKO Flutter Mane after Terastallization even when Ogerpon-H is Intimidated.

  • The bulk investment allows Ogerpon-H to live most Choice Scarf Urshifu-R's Tera Water Surging Strikes while having a favorable roll to survive Timid Landorus's Sludge Bomb.

movesets.name: Offensive Redirector
movesets.description:
Ogerpon-H is a spectacular Pokemon in Regulation G thanks to Follow Me combined with its offensive presence. Its STAB combination allows it to threaten many metagame staples, such as Rillaboom, Amoonguss, Calyrex-I, and Urshifu-R, for massive damage. Ogerpon-H prefers to use Wood Hammer to ensure OHKOs on Urshifu-R and bulky Kyogre; however, Horn Leech is used alongside the defensive sets for more survivability while still 2HKOing the aforementioned Water-types. Grassy Glide is a niche option, providing Ogerpon-H with a powerful priority move alongside Rillaboom and allowing Ogerpon-H to attack faster threats like Calyrex-S and Choice Scarf Urshifu-R before they move. The HP and Defense investment ensures that Ogerpon-H survives Tera Stellar Icicle Crash from Chien-Pao and almost always lives Tera Water Surging Strikes from Urshifu-R. The Speed EVs allow Ogerpon-H to outspeed Modest Landorus, and the rest is to maximize Attack. Ogerpon-H can use a much bulkier EV spread of 220 HP / 12 Atk / 252 Def / 4 SpD / 20 Spe with an Impish nature, which allows it to avoid the 2HKO from Chien-Pao's Ice Spinner, Calyrex-I's Glacial Lance, and Iron Hands's Quark Drive-boosted Drain Punch as well as surviving +1 Tera Fire Ivy Cudgel from opposing Ogerpon-H. The Speed investment allows Ogerpon-H to outspeed neutral-natured base 80 Speed Pokemon such as Regidrago.

Ogerpon-H especially struggles with Incineroar, which stomachs its attacks and weakens it with Intimidate and Parting Shot. Dragon-types like Raging Bolt and Roaring Moon are also problematic, taking its attacks and threatening massive damage with Draco Meteor and Acrobatics respectively. Landorus can also be threatening thanks to being able to threaten Ogerpon-H before and after it Terastallizes with Sludge Bomb and Earth Power respectively. Urshifu-R and Landorus make for excellent partners, as they threaten OHKOs on many of the aforementioned Pokemon with their STAB moves. The two also appreciate Ogerpon-H's support, as it can protect them from threatening Pokemon like Rillaboom and Chien-Pao with Follow Me. Miraidon makes excellent use of Ogerpon-H, as it appreciates Ogerpon-H threatening common checks like Rillaboom and Zacian-C with Ivy Cudgel and stomaching their attacks with Follow Me. Calyrex-I is another Restricted Pokemon that works well with Ogerpon-H, as it threatens Landorus and Raging Bolt with Glacial Lance. Calyrex-I has an easier time setting up Trick Room and dealing with disruptive status moves such as Amoonguss's Spore and Incineroar's Will-O-Wisp thanks to Ogerpon-H's Follow Me. Ogerpon-H also threatens foes that resist Glacial Lance like Zamazenta-C, Urshifu-R, and opposing Calyrex-I. Groudon also works particularly well with Ogerpon-H, threatening super effective damage on Incineroar and Raging Bolt with Precipice Blades, while bolstering Ogerpon-H's damage output with sun. Ogerpon-H can support Groudon by redirecting attacks from Rillaboom and Chien-Pao while also threatening Kyogre with its Grass-type STAB attacks, all of which are difficult matchups for Groudon. Powerful setup sweepers such as Calyex-S and Calm Mind Terapagos also make great use of Ogerpon-H. Ogerpon-H can help them set up by redirecting away powerful attacks such as Urshifu-S's Sucker Punch and Drain Punch from Iron Hands as well as disruptive moves like Amoonguss's Spore and Incineroar's Parting Shot. Ogerpon-H is also helpful offensively, as it can threaten otherwise problematic Pokemon like Chien-Pao and Urshifu-R with Ivy Cudgel and its Grass-type move of choice respectively.

movesets.name: Offensive Redirector
movesets.description:
Set Details

  • With its immunity to Spore from Amoonguss and Brute Bonnet, Ogerpon-H is able to use Follow Me to support its allies while offensively putting pressure on common threats such as Rillaboom and Urshifu-R. Additionally, Ogerpon-H matches up well offensively into Calyrex-I and Zacian-C.
  • Wood Hammer is the most common Grass-type STAB option on Ogerpon-H for its high and consistent damage output, notably OHKOing Urshifu-R. Grassy Glide can be used as a niche option when paired with Rillaboom for powerful priority in Grassy Terrain.
  • This EV spread allows Ogerpon to almost always take a Tera Water Surging Strikes from Urshifu-R, a +1 Glacial Lance from most Calyrex-I, or a Choice Specs Draco Meteor from Timid Miraidon under Light Screen. It is also able to OHKO Rillaboom with Ivy Cudgel, outspeed Modest Landorus-I, and pick up an OHKO on both Calyrex formes with +1 Attack Tera Fire Ivy Cudgel.

Teambuilding

  • Incineroar can be very problematic for Ogerpon-H, reducing its damage output with Intimidate and Parting Shot and resisting its STAB moves. Other Dragon- and Fire-types such as Koraidon and Chi-Yu can also threaten Ogerpon-H while resisting its STAB combination.
  • Ogerpon-C can outspeed and threaten Ogerpon-H with an OHKO with Ivy Cudgel, while other fast threats, including Calyrex-S and Miraidon, can outspeed and threaten it with huge damage. Ogerpon-H can also struggle against powerful spread damage from Calyrex-I and Terapagos, which ignore Follow Me.
  • Ogerpon-H pairs well with Calyrex-S and Zamazenta-C, as it can protect both from powerful attacks and notably allows Calyrex-S to set up, while Calyrex-S is able to threaten Koraidon and Zamazenta threatens Incineroar for Ogerpon-H. Miraidon also benefits greatly from redirection from Ogerpon-H as well as its ability to threaten Rillaboom with an OHKO using Ivy Cudgel, while Miraidon can threaten Incineroar and Dragon-types for Ogerpon-H.
  • Calyrex-I also greatly appreciates redirection support, helping it to set up Trick Room and sweep, while Calyrex-I can hit the Dragon-types that can stifle Ogerpon-H's offense and allows Ogerpon-H to threaten faster foes with Trick Room.
  • Urshifu-R is a strong partner for Ogerpon-H, as together, they form a potent offensive core. Urshifu-R appreciates redirection to safely dish out huge damage, while it can threaten Incineroar and, with Tera Water, KO Ogerpon-C and Calyrex-S for Ogerpon-H. Rillaboom is another strong partner, as Follow Me support allows for it to safely pivot with U-turn while Rillaboom's Grassy Terrain bolsters Ogerpon-H's Grass-type moves and provides priority to Ogerpon-H's Grassy Glide.

movesets.name: Swords Dance
movesets.description: Thanks to its great Attack stat, its strong STAB moves, and Swords Dance, Ogerpon-H is a powerful wallbreaker that's able to threaten common physical walls like Deoxys-D and non-Well-Baked Body Corviknight. Power Whip OHKOes defensive Great Tusk at +2 and has a good chance to OHKO offensive Great Tusk, while Horn Leech trades power for healing and a guaranteed chance to hit. Play Rough threatens Dragon-types like Dragonite and Roaring Moon looking to switch in, while Knock Off has a high chance of OHKOing Well-Baked Body Gholdengo at +2 and hinders switch-ins like Primordial Sea Zapdos and Well-Baked Body Mandibuzz and Corviknight. Fast cleaners like Choice Scarf Azelf and Chien-Pao appreciate Ogerpon-H's ability to threaten their switch-ins like RegenVest Swampert and Intimidate Corviknight, respectively, paving the way for them to clean late-game. Ogerpon-H's middling bulk and only decent Speed stat leave it threatened by many faster offensive foes like Roaring Moon and Iron Boulder, so teammates that can deal with them offensively like the aforementioned Choice Scarf Azelf and Chien-Pao or defensively like Great Tusk and Corviknight, which can also remove the entry hazards that Ogerpon-H is prone to getting worn down by, are appreciated. Entry hazard support from the likes of Great Tusk and Heatran is also appreciated, as it helps Ogerpon-H KO foes like Gholdengo and Deoxys-D.

strategies.overview:
Draft Order: Round 4 onwards

Price Range: 11-12 points

Overview: Ogerpon-H boasts an amazing offensive typing and ability, making it a great physical wallbreaker and potential setup sweeper thanks to its access to Swords Dance. In addition to its offensive typing, Ogerpon-H has a great coverage movepool to deal with common defensive checks to its dual STAB combination. However, Ogerpon-H must hold its Hearthflame Mask as an item, making it unable to hold another item like Heavy-Duty Boots or Choice Scarf. Thus, Ogerpon-H requires lots of support in teambuilding with entry hazard and speed control Pokemon being a must, while defensive pivots are greatly appreciated.
strategies.comments:
Common Roles

Setup Sweeper: With Swords Dance and Trailblaze, Ogerpon-H can quickly overwhelm the opponent's team if they are not careful. Its amazing offensive typing and ability allow Ogerpon-H to virtually have no defensive switch-ins, with Unaware walls like Skeledirge and Clefable not being exceptions due to Mold Breaker if Ogerpon-H hasn't Terastallized.

Support: While taking away from its offensive capabilities, Ogerpon-H is able to fulfill supporting roles depending on the matchup. With options such as Spikes, Knock Off, U-turn, Taunt, and Leech Seed, it is a viable way to catch opponents off guard and allow your other wallbreakers to excel in the matchup.

Common Moves

Primary STAB Moves: Ivy Cudgel, Power Whip, Wood Hammer, Horn Leech

Setup Moves: Swords Dance, Trailblaze

Utility Moves: Substitute, Encore, Taunt, Spikes

Coverage: Knock Off, Play Rough, Stomping Tantrum, Superpower, Low Kick, Zen Headbutt, U-turn

Niche Moves

Spiky Shield: As Ogerpon-H is generally vulnerable to Choice Scarf users, Spiky Shield is an asset in determining what the foe may lock themselves into. Furthermore, it chips down physical attackers, which may help Ogerpon-H secure a KO it otherwise could not, and it pairs well with another niche move, Leech Seed. Overall, Spiky Shield is a nice scouting option for such an offensive threat to have.

Quick Attack: It's Ogerpon-H's only form of priority aside from Grassy Glide in Grassy Terrain, acting as a useful tool to pick off faster and generally frail Pokemon late-game after a boost from Swords Dance, Embody Aspect, or both.

Rock Tomb: Rock Tomb is a coverage move available to Ogerpon-H, which will only see use in matchups against dual Fire- and Flying-types in Talonflame and Moltres.

Synthesis: Synthesis gives Ogerpon-H a recovery option in case entry hazards are hard to remove, allowing Ogerpon-H to have more opportunities to enter the field.

Common Items

Hearthflame Mask: Ogerpon-H must hold this item.

Tera

Ogerpon-H is typically Tera-banned. If Ogerpon-H is allowed to Tera, it should be your primary Tera Captain. Its special ability, Embody Aspect, immediately provides an increase in power, making Ogerpon-H a top-tier threat that is almost impossible to switch into. The only Tera type available is Fire, which is a key downside defensively, adding two new weaknesses in Water and Ground.

Draft Strategy

Ogerpon-H is not unstoppable by any means, and it should be supported by top-tier special wallbreakers that complement its offensive typing. When drafting, entry hazard and speed control are must-haves, as Ogerpon-H is unable to hold items to alleviate these key weaknesses. Bringing in Ogerpon-H is an important factor to consider, with pivots being appreciated in allowing Ogerpon-H to come in on a favorable matchup.

Entry Hazard Removal: Due to Ogerpon-H's weakness to hazards, at least one strong hazard control option is required. Rapid Spin is the preferred option to Defog so that you are able to keep up your own hazards. Top-tier Pokemon like Great Tusk, Iron Treads, and Terapagos fulfill the role and much more, while Blastoise and Tentacruel are great budget options for hazard control.

Speed Control: With Ogerpon-H having a static base 110 Speed due to the inability to hold a Choice Scarf, it is not ideal for it to be your fastest pokemon. Therefore, it is strongly recommended to draft at least one of the following: a naturally faster pokemon, a good Choice Scarf user, or a priority attack user. Options include Greninja, Tornadus-T, and Palafin.

Special Wallbreakers: Ogerpon-H greatly appreciates special wallbreakers, which can supply additional pressure both in teambuilding and in games, often allowing Ogerpon-H to be less prepared for. Great partners include Ursaluna-B, Gholdengo, and Raging Bolt.

Defensive Pivots: Bringing in Ogerpon-H is often a challenge due to the aforementioned hazard problem, as well as mediocre defenses, yet having a defensive pivot truly helps Ogerpon-H pressure foes. Both Slowking formes and Tornadus-T are great options with Regenerator, while Corviknight and Mandibuzz synergize well with Ogerpon-H while providing a hazard removal option.

Checks and Counters

Entry Hazards: Not being able to run Heavy-Duty Boots is a severe handicap for Ogerpon-H as a grounded Fire-type. Affected by all hazards, Ogerpon-H will have a tough time switching in many times without proper hazard control.

Faster Pokemon: Ogerpon-H is a sitting duck against naturally faster Pokemon and Choice Scarf users, impeded yet again by its inability to utilize items such as its own Choice Scarf. Specifically, Pokemon like Greninja and Sneasler are able to force Ogerpon-H out.

Priority Attack Users: With Ogerpon-H's average bulk, priority moves are able to do considerable amounts of damage. Extreme Speed from Dragonite and Jet Punch from Palafin-H are able to force out Ogerpon-H if its health is low or it's not behind a Substitute.

movesets.name: Swords Dance
movesets.description: Ogerpon-H is an incredibly potent stallbreaker and sweeper in Ubers UU due to Mold Breaker and Swords Dance. Trailblaze allows Ogerpon-H to boost its Speed past that of usually faster Pokemon, such as Deoxys, Dragapult, Zacian, Choice Scarf Chi-Yu, and Choice Scarf Landorus. Power Whip and Horn Leech can be run as stronger Grass-type moves to hit Palafin and Great Tusk for super effective damage. Ivy Cudgel gives Ogerpon-H a strong, non-contact Fire-type STAB move to hit Magearna and Skarmory with while avoiding Rocky Helmet chip damage. Play Rough is for Dragon-types like Giratina and Reshiram that resist its STAB moves, whereas Knock Off is for general utility and hits Mewtwo and Lugia. Terastallizing Ogerpon-H gives it an Attack boost, letting it grab OHKOs on bulky neutral Pokemon like Zacian and Dialga without a Swords Dance boost. Ogerpon-H is best dealt with using offensive counterplay that takes advantage of its poor bulk, as Pokemon like Deoxys, Zacian, Choice Scarf Landorus, Chi-Yu, and Palafin can outrun and KO it. Defensively, almost nothing can take Ogerpon-H on, as Mold Breaker ignores Unaware, so only the likes of Moltres can safely handle it. Entry hazards are also a huge problem for Ogerpon-H, as it cannot hold Heavy-Duty Boots, meaning it will take significant chip damage when hitting the battlefield. Ogerpon-H especially appreciates support from Corviknight, which can help Ogerpon-H safely hit the field and remove hazards. Ogerpon-H also forms strong offensive cores with priority users like Rillaboom, Palafin, and Arceus formes due to them being able to eliminate the few faster threats in the metagame. Ogerpon-H also pairs uniquely well with Sticky Web Galvantula, as the foes' Speed drops let it move before everything in the unboosted metagame besides priority users, making it much more threatening.

movesets.name: All-out Attacker
movesets.description: Ogerpon-H is a fearsome wallbreaker and late-game cleaner in Ubers UU. Power Whip is a strong STAB option, hitting important damage thresholds on Great Tusk, Toxapex, and Arceus formes, but Horn Leech's healing effect can offset chip damage from entry hazards, making it a solid alternative. Play Rough hits Dragon-types like Giratina and Palkia-O hard. Trailblaze boosting Ogerpon-H's Speed allows it to outpace most of the metagame, notably Zacian, Mewtwo, Deoxys, and Arceus formes. Tera Fire boosts Ogerpon-H's damage meteorically, allowing it to OHKO Pokemon like Zacian, Landorus, and Palkia-O. Ogerpon-H can have issues breaking through Pokemon like bulky Arceus formes and Giratina without Terastalizing, as they can shrug off its coverage moves, so Pokemon that can break through these threats like Palkia-O, Zacian, and Ice Beam Mewtwo are excellent partners. Ogerpon-H's wallbreaking prowess makes it an excellent partner to late-game cleaners like Zacian, Chi-Yu, and Kyurem-W, which appreciate it beating Pokemon like Dondozo, Solgaleo, and Magearna that could otherwise stop their sweep. Ogerpon-H's also cannot hold Heavy-Duty Boots, as it is locked into using Hearthflame Mask, so hazard control from Great Tusk and Giratina is appreciated.

movesets.name: Utility Attacker
movesets.description: • Stomping Tantrum allows Ogerpon-H to deal with Heatran after terastallizing.
